svg.title: Strands Decider on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore GPU Instances
svg.desc: Verified Python direct-code deployment in us-east-1: IAM-authorized InvokeAgentRuntime calls share one native Runtime session and one AgentCore-managed g5.xlarge. Eight application-owned business sessions share one native CUDA model. Private S3 provides code and model artifacts. ADOT exports traces to CloudWatch; evaluate.py submits actual traces to AgentCore Evaluations. Context changes, fine tuning and regression promotion are future work. The verified subnet is public with no security-group ingress. The test GPU has been released.
